A nineteen-year-old scholarship student at the Cog-College of Cograuncy, born to a Ferran furnace-town family of modest means. Caedon is lean and wiry from years hauling coke on the furnace floors, with dark tousled hair, storm-grey eyes, and a smear of engine soot that never quite washes out from under his nails. He carries himself with a watchful, self-taught steadiness — the wariness of someone who has always been the outsider in a room of guild-born peers.

Unusually, Caedon draws on both Currents — a faint pull of ordered Sela and wild Vash alike — a rarity the College has not yet decided whether to prize or fear. He channels without a Governor by instinct, which terrifies his professors and thrills the Kiln-Sworn recruiters. Earnest, stubborn, and quick to defend those the guild-state overlooks, he is the still point around whom the other students orbit.

The seat of Assayer power in Vorn: a fortress-chapter house of grey basalt and cold iron, its great door marked with the single iron key of the Grey Hands. Vaults hold rows of Nullifier Governors and the ledgers of the severed; the air is incense and machine-oil at once. This is where corruption reaches highest and where Isolde turns her faith into a weapon against its makers — walking in on a devotion she no longer owes.

Here's what I found: there's no `art_style` anywhere yet. `project.yaml` only has `title` and `start` — no `art_style` field, no model ids. And there are **no** style references in any character sheet, location sheet, or the wiki (my searches for "style"/"art_style" came back empty). The sheets describe *content* (who/what things are), not *rendering style*.

That matters because the generator applies one global `art_style` to everything. So the clean, complete way to make the whole VN Japanese-anime is to set `art_style` in `project.yaml` — that's the single lever that reaches every character and location. Nothing in the sheets currently contradicts an anime look, so there's nothing to strip out.

full:
Done. The whole VN is now set to a Japanese-anime visual style.

**What changed (committed `6afbfa1b`):**
- `project.yaml` — added `art_style: "Japanese anime"`. This is the single global lever the generator applies to every character portrait/model-sheet and every location plate, so it reaches "everything" on the next render.
- `AICONTEXT.md` — added a durable note so any future character/location work stays on-style.
- `AICONTEXT.generated.md` — refreshed project map.

**Validation:** 0 errors. The 8 warnings are the pre-existing unreachable-scene ones (the Wren route and the dark-arc scenes were already unlinked before this change) — not caused by this edit and non-blocking.

**Worth knowing:** none of the content sheets needed touching — none contained conflicting style language, and they describe *what* things are, not *how* they're drawn. If you later want a scene or character to deviate (e.g. a specific painterly flashback), that's done per-entity via `art_notes`, layered on top of this global style. Just say which one.
